readme_notes: IMPORTANT: Play OFFLINE only with Easy Anti-Cheat (EAC) disabled.
If using Mod Engine 2, rename dinput8.dll to mc_eldenring_adapter.dll and add it to config_eldenring.toml under external_dlls.

Default hotkeys: F6 = Toggle MC Mode, F5 = Toggle Creative/Survival Mode, F10 = First Person View, I = Inventory, F2 / Spawn Egg = Summon Zombies, Left-Click = Attack/Mine, Right-Click = Eat/Interact.
